what_this_is: P2-gp153 follow-up for les:n5-comparacoes-01: the three claims comparacoes_fixes.verdict.json listed in found_not_in_scope (three orders counted where the lesson defines two; より + ほうが claimed to resolve every comparison; のほうが called a particle). Minimal span edits, every example and the lesson voice kept.
source_body: git HEAD research/derived/lessons/n5-comparacoes-01.json body (the course/ export differs only in vocab ref ids; every old_span counts 1 in both)
apply_contract: per lesson, in table order: body.count(old_span) == count, then body = body.replace(old_span, new_span). Both layers: research/derived/lessons/<slug>.json body and localized_text(lesson, body, pt-BR).
checked: each old_span count 1 in the HEAD body; all rows applied in order leave LessonParser with 0 errors

edits.old_span: O japonês resolve toda comparação entre duas coisas com duas pecinhas: a partícula
edits.new_span: Para comparar duas coisas, o japonês conta com duas pecinhas-chave: a partícula
edits.why: research/derived/pending/comparacoes_fixes.verdict.json found_not_in_scope[1]: 'resolve toda comparação ... com duas pecinhas' is false, the lesson's own first mold は…より…です has no ほうが. Now names the two key pieces without claiming every comparison uses both.

edits.old_span: você tem o par </text><jp>のほうが … より</jp><text>, que cobre qualquer comparação entre dois itens.
edits.new_span: você tem o par </text><jp>のほうが … より</jp><text>, um dos jeitos mais usados de comparar dois itens.
edits.why: research/derived/pending/comparacoes_fixes.verdict.json found_not_in_scope[1]: same false generalization ('cobre qualquer comparação'); the pair is one of three molds taught here, not the only one.

research/derived/pending/comparacoes_fixes.verdict.json found_not_in_scope[0]: by the lesson's own definition of ordem ('A ordem é flexível': which block comes first), は…より…です and のほうが…より both start with the winning side, so there are two orders.

edits.old_span: Três moldes cobrem "A é mais X que B", um para cada ordem.
edits.new_span: Três moldes cobrem "A é mais X que B", em só duas ordens: o primeiro e o terceiro começam pelo lado que ganha, e o segundo começa pelo "do que".
edits.why: research/derived/pending/comparacoes_fixes.verdict.json found_not_in_scope[0]: 'um para cada ordem' counts three orders; now says which molds share an order, consistent with the next sentences (winner takes は in the first, のほうが in the other two, which differ only by where the sentence starts).

edits.old_span: as partículas </text><jp>より</jp><text> e </text><jp>のほうが</jp><text> dizem sozinhas
edits.new_span: a partícula </text><jp>より</jp><text> e a expressão </text><jp>のほうが</jp><text> dizem sozinhas
edits.why: research/derived/pending/comparacoes_fixes.verdict.json found_not_in_scope[2]: calls のほうが a particle; ほう（方）is a noun ('lado', as the lesson itself says), so のほうが is の + noun + が. Same slip w08b_merges.verdict.json fixed in yori-hou-ga#nuance.
